(Estted. under the Panjab University Act VII of 1947 – enacted by the Govt. of India)
Date 19-07-2023 Ref. No. PURCK/2023/1340D
Advertisement Notice of Guest Faculty
Applications are invited for appointing Guest Faculty to teach at Panjab University Rural Centre Kauni,
Sri Muktsar Sahib for the Academic Session 2023-24 (Odd Semester) for the following subjects:
Sr.
No.
Subject Date. No. of Vacancies Last Date to receive application
form in the office of P.U. Rural
Centre, Kauni
Time
1. English 01 03-08-2023 upto 03:00 PM
2. Commerce 01 03-08-2023 upto 03:00 PM
3. Management 01 03-08-2023 upto 03:00 PM
The applicants are required to fill the application form for Assistant Professor
available on Panjab University Website (http://forms.puchd.ac.in/forms/20200122155429-
directrecruitmentassistantprofessorapplicationformasperugcregulation2018.pdf) (page 1 to 12). The
candidates should send prescribed application form along with supporting documents and attested copies
of all the certificates/documents (Two copies each) and two passport size photographs upto 03.08.2023 in
the office of Panjab University Rural Centre Kauni.
The Above assignment will be on lecture basis with a token honorarium of Rs. 1500/-
per lecture with an upper limit of Rs. 50,000/- per month. The candidate shall have to give an undertaking
that he/she will not draw any fellowship/stipend or any financial assistance from any agency till he/she is
teaching in the Department of Panjab University Rural Centre kauni as a Guest Faculty.
Contact at purckauni@pu.ac.in and 01633-292000 for any enquiry.
Note:- The date and time for walk in interview will be intimated to the eligible candidates.
Minimum Qualification is as per UGC norms.
Sd/-
DIRECTOR
PURC Kauni
Sri Muktsar Sahib.
